meta.name: notion_synthesize
meta.description: Synthesize durable ktx wiki pages and semantic-layer sources from staged Notion pages, databases, data-source rows, and clustered Notion evidence. Load when a WorkUnit contains Notion raw files or Notion evidence chunks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Notion页面整理为结构化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常从Notion收集零散信息并需要生成结构化知识
copy.tagline_en: Organize Notion pages into structured knowledge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often collect scattered info from Notion and need structured knowledge

howto.what: 当工作单元包含 Notion 原始文件或证据块时，Claude 会读取这些内容，然后编写持久的 wiki 页面和语义层来源，将知识综合起来。它会优先更新现有页面，而不是创建重复内容。
howto.when: 当工作单元包含来自 pages/、databases/、data-sources/ 的 Notion 内容，或包含聚类的 Notion 证据块时触发。

say.text: 请综合这些 Notion 页面，写出 wiki 条目。
say.note: Claude 会读取页面并生成 wiki。

say.text: 检查这些 Notion 内容中是否有可复用的数据集或指标。
say.note: Claude 会搜索现有语义层来源并更新。

say.text: 处理这个工作单元中的 Notion 证据块。
say.note: Claude 会读取证据并综合知识。

howto.what_en: When a WorkUnit contains Notion raw files or evidence chunks, Claude reads the content and writes durable wiki pages and semantic-layer sources to synthesize the knowledge. It prefers updating existing pages over creating duplicates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a WorkUnit contains Notion content from pages/, databases/, data-sources/, or clustered Notion evidence chunks.

say_en.text: Synthesize these Notion pages into wiki entries.
say_en.note: Claude reads pages and generates wiki.

say_en.text: Check these Notion contents for reusable datasets or metrics.
say_en.note: Claude searches existing SL sources and updates.

say_en.text: Process the Notion evidence chunks in this WorkUnit.
say_en.note: Claude reads evidence and synthesizes knowledge.
